decisions.reason: As a newly launched and prominently branded product line closely tied to the firm's software core, it has strategic upside and too little time in market so far to justify abandonment.

The education institute is more peripheral and likely costlier to run than a software add-on, but after only about a year it still makes sense to keep the option open while testing customer demand in the firm's dental ecosystem.
A remote support tool fits the installed customer base and should be relatively inexpensive to maintain, so real-options logic favors retaining it until clearer evidence of weak value appears.
